question: Does giving the Governor non-Governor binding ballots change measured committee agreement, conditional on identical preceding arguments, own state and non-Governor ballots?
importance: Tests whether an informational privilege at binding voting creates a consensus effect that could otherwise be attributed to deliberation. Institutional protocol measurement beyond a geographical transfer.
novelty_limit: July 2026 abstract already discusses consensus. Its full methods are unavailable; uniqueness and importance relative to the complete revision are unverified.
claim_scope: Simulator-local protocol effect conditional on the generated common prefix. No real-MPC persuasion, superior policy, cognitive validity, equilibrium or welfare claim.
primary_estimand: Average meeting-level difference in final joint rate-and-stance pairwise ballot agreement: ballots-visible minus ballots-hidden; average planned stochastic replicate differences within each meeting first.

primary_endpoint.joint_ballot_agreement: Number of unordered member pairs agreeing on BOTH exact rate change and stance divided by 15; all six valid final ballots required

secondary_consensus_endpoints: Mean absolute pairwise rate distance in bps
Final-minus-initial round agreement and rate dispersion, separated by branch
forecasting_endpoints: Secondary descriptive exact rate, bps MAE, hike/cut/hold and stance. Committee unresolved aggregation remains missing. No general forecasting-superiority claim.
dissent_endpoints: Exact-rate preference disagreement and formal stance disagreement computed separately. Literal YES/NO, reservations and guidance disagreement are not silently converted.

cohort.eligibility: Each supplied observation available before its exclusive cutoff and source hash supported; all six members verified from pre-cutoff roster sources; each persona has at least one pre-cutoff personal statement and verified corpus manifest; supported rate/stance ontology. History eligibility alone is insufficient. No post-outcome discretionary exclusions.
cohort.minimum_regime_coverage: At least four hikes and four holds in candidate cohort; no cut regime represented, so no all-regime forecasting claim.
cohort.already_exposed: All candidate 2020-2024 outcomes were inspected in development; retrospective evaluation only.

labels_and_missingness: Retain independent source annotations with source paragraphs. Unknown formal stance stays null; no imputation. Report complete/observed target counts and paired logical completion bounds for secondary dissent. Missing labels do not gate consensus from generated ballots.
personas: Fixed existing lexical rule over strictly prior personal statements; no calibration outcomes in extraction; no new model biography or inferred structural preference. Exact executable persona bytes and dated manifests are not yet available and cannot be represented as frozen.

model_and_prompts.seeds: Existing planned_seed version paired-member-round-v1; base42; replicate IDs1,2; branch Governor calls share requested seed but provider determinism is not assumed.
model_and_prompts.identity_and_date: Retain names/dates; acknowledge potential pretrained historical contamination. Prefix is identical across treatment branches. No memorization-removal claim.
model_and_prompts.common_prompts: Existing four-round system/tasks and own state; no forced consensus. Final Governor contexts differ ONLY in availability of fixed non-Governor final ballots. Exact paired-prefix adapter/prompt bytes do not yet exist; executable freeze incomplete.

conditions.common_prefix: Generate R1-R3 for all six (18 calls) and R4 for five non-Governors (5 calls) once per meeting/replicate. Preserve this common raw input with immutable origin request identities.
conditions.ballots_visible: Fresh Governor R4 receives common own/peer R1-R3 plus five non-Governor final ballots.
conditions.ballots_hidden: Fresh Governor R4 receives the same own/peer R1-R3, without those five final ballots.
conditions.order: Five non-Governors followed by Governor; fixed in both. Randomized branch submission order via prespecified SHA256 of meeting/replicate parity.
conditions.reused_prefix_evidence: Shared generated input, not a second independent generation or cache replay labeled fresh. Branch calls must be fresh and logged under separate identities.
conditions.controls: The smallest two-branch contrast tests binding-ballot privilege. It does not identify full deliberation or peer persuasion. Full/independent/joint/macro-only comparisons are excluded from the primary analysis.

comparators: Primary matched branch control; initial-round agreement as descriptive reference. Hold and published-prior persistence plus calibration-selected constant dissent only for descriptive forecasting/dissent. Taylor is a distinct mechanical comparator, excluded from the primary causal contrast.
aggregation: Default categorical majority/binary casting, six-person simulator roster. Preserve unresolved multi-action ballots; no undocumented synthetic resolver. Consensus can be computed from valid ballots even if committee resolution is undefined; implementation for this separation is pending.

resource_policy.tariff_status: October5 stored tariff; not freshly verified for execution
resource_policy.launch_rule: Do not launch until the existing allowance is reconciled, current tariff/quota verified, immutable executable inputs/adapter integrated, and whole batch plus closeout fits the activation deadline. The numeric design is not authorization to reset ledger or spend an unverified remainder.
resource_policy.token_matching: Equal branch call/output caps; input length differs by intended ballot treatment. Report actual tokens/cost and do not claim equal tokens. Reject prompts above bound.

failure_rules: No retries, model substitution or heuristic fallback. Budget/cancellation/provenance/provider/schema failure halts the batch. Preserve every incomplete prefix/branch. Do not regenerate a prefix until agreement appears. Report planned/completed meetings and pairs; incomplete pair effects remain missing, with worst-case conditional completion bounds [-1/3,+1/3]; failures may be informative. Undefined institutional aggregation is recorded separately from invalid model output.

analysis.unit: Meeting; not member, round, call or replicate
analysis.estimate: Mean of within-meeting mean paired differences; publish every meeting/replicate value and failure.
analysis.uncertainty: Paired temporal moving-block bootstrap, block length3, 10000 resamples, seed20261010; percentile95% interval; sensitivity block lengths2,4. Small dependent cohort limits inference. No optional stopping or equivalence claim from nonsignificance.
analysis.multiplicity: One primary endpoint; secondary endpoints descriptive with intervals and no confirmatory significance claims.
analysis.sample_adequacy: Maximum23 dependent meetings; no power claim. Report achieved precision and serial/block sensitivity. An imprecise estimate cannot establish no effect or equivalence. Minimum12 is an operational estimation floor, not proof of adequate power.
analysis.independent_recomputation: Reconstruct all ballots/consensus endpoints directly from raw frozen generation records and common prefixes, checking request/code/input identities; verify sources, not merely producer summaries.

unmet_executable_freeze_fields: Paired-prefix/branch integration and exact frozen prompt identities
Current tariff/quota and complete prospective command
post_review_policy: No scientific repair loop after final critique. New objections enter gap report; any later specification change needs new instruction and is unreviewed.
